resources.title: Agriculture Knowledge Centre
resources.text: Practical, easy-to-follow guidance for everyday farming decisions. Explore a topic, find a starting point and use trusted government resources when you need official information.
resources.libraryText: Start with a topic below. Each guide gives you a practical overview and points you towards the next thing to learn.
resources.cropText: Think through seasonal planning, crop selection, sowing windows, field preparation and basic crop-care routines.
resources.soilText: Learn why soil testing matters, how to read a soil health card and how to think about balanced nutrient use.
resources.waterText: Explore irrigation methods, water conservation, drainage and the basics of efficient water use on the farm.
resources.pestText: Understand early identification, field monitoring, prevention and when to seek advice from a qualified agriculture expert.
resources.seedsText: Review seed quality, safe storage, treatment basics and how to assess equipment needs before purchasing.
resources.insuranceText: Understand crop insurance basics, weather-related risks, records to keep and where to check notified coverage.
resources.noResultsText: Try another word or clear the selected filters.
resources.officialText: Use official portals for current notices, application windows, beneficiary status and scheme-specific instructions.

official.soilText: Soil health services and related information

resources.disclaimer: These guides are general educational information, not a substitute for local agronomic advice. Scheme rules, dates and benefits can change; confirm details on the official portal or with the implementing department.
resources.guideSafety: These are general learning guidelines. Exact crop practices, varieties, sowing dates, seed rates, nutrient doses and plant-protection decisions vary by district, soil, season and official recommendations. Confirm locally with your Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or state agriculture department.
resources.guideSourceNote: Use local KVK and state agriculture recommendations for field-level decisions.

about.title: Making agricultural support easier to understand.
about.text: KrishiAssist brings scheme discovery, eligibility guidance and practical next steps together in one farmer-friendly place.
about.whyTitle: Finding the right support should not feel complicated.
about.whyText: Information about government schemes can be spread across portals, notices and department documents. Eligibility rules may be difficult to interpret, and farmers may be unsure which documents or steps to prepare. KrishiAssist is designed to make that information easier to navigate.
about.solutionTitle: From scattered information to clearer next steps.
about.solutionText: Use one place to explore schemes, understand the conditions that may apply to your profile, see why a result was reached and prepare for the next part of the process. The platform aims to explain—not replace—the official process.
about.workflowTitle: A simple journey, step by step

steps.profileText: Add relevant details about your location, farming activity and land so scheme guidance can be more relevant.
steps.discoverText: Browse the scheme catalogue or describe the support you are looking for.
steps.checkText: Review which conditions appear satisfied, which need more information and why.
steps.prepareText: Review document checklists, application guidance and official links before applying.

principles.accessibleText: Clear language and English, Hindi and Hinglish options help make information easier to follow.
principles.transparentText: Eligibility results show the conditions behind the assessment instead of presenting an unexplained label.
principles.privacyText: Only provide information needed for the feature you choose. Avoid sharing passwords or unnecessary sensitive documents.
principles.farmerFirstText: Practical steps, readable explanations and useful links are prioritised over technical jargon.

about.importantText: KrishiAssist is an informational assistance platform. Its eligibility checks are indicative and depend on the profile information and scheme data available. They are not an official approval or guarantee of benefits. Final decisions, current rules and application status are determined by the relevant government department.

contact.title: How can we help you?
contact.text: Find the right route for scheme questions, official grievances or feedback about the KrishiAssist platform.
contact.helpText: KrishiAssist is an independent information tool. For official decisions, application status or corrections to a government record, contact the department responsible for that scheme.
contact.schemeHelpText: For current eligibility, application dates, documents or payment status, contact the scheme’s implementing department or use its official portal.
contact.portalHelpText: For a grievance about a central government service, use the official public grievance portal and keep your reference number.
contact.privacyText: Do not include Aadhaar numbers, bank account details, passwords, OTPs or full identity documents in a general enquiry.

contact.formText: Fill in the details and copy the message. This demo prepares a message on your device; it does not send or store it.
